title: John Lennon watches Bobby ‘Blue’ Bland perform in Los Angeles | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Phil Spector watched Bobby ‘Blue’ Bland perform at the Whisky A Go Go in Los Angeles, USA, on 7 November 1973.

Bland was promoting his eighth album His California Album, which was released earlier in 1973. Spector was ejected from the venue after shouting abuse to the support act, gospel group The Dixie Hummingbirds.
